breve: A server interface for screen reader support.

metodos.desc:
Creates a new, empty accessibility element resource.
Note: An accessibility element is created and freed automatically for each Node. In general, this function should not be called manually.

metodos.assinatura: create_sub_element(parent_rid: RID, role: AccessibilityServer.AccessibilityRole, insert_pos: int = -1) -> RID
metodos.desc: Creates a new, empty accessibility sub-element resource. Sub-elements can be used to provide accessibility information for objects which are not Nodes, such as list items, table cells, or menu items. Sub-elements are freed automatically when the parent element is freed, or can be freed early using the 'free_element' method.

metodos.assinatura: create_sub_text_edit_elements(parent_rid: RID, shaped_text: RID, min_height: float, insert_pos: int = -1, is_last_line: bool = false) -> RID
metodos.desc:
Creates a new, empty accessibility sub-element from the shaped text buffer. Sub-elements are freed automatically when the parent element is freed, or can be freed early using the 'free_element' method.
If 'is_last_line' is true, no trailing newline is appended to the text content. Set to true for the last line in multi-line text fields and for single-line text fields.
Returns the metadata of the accessibility element 'id'.
Sets the metadata of the accessibility element 'id' to 'meta'.
Frees the accessibility element 'id' created by 'create_element', 'create_sub_element', or 'create_sub_text_edit_elements'.
Returns the main accessibility element of the OS native window.
Returns true if 'id' is a valid accessibility element.
Returns true if screen reader is support by this implementation.

Sets the window focused state for assistive apps.
Note: This method is implemented on Linux, macOS, and Windows.
Note: Advanced users only! Window objects call this method automatically.

metodos.assinatura: set_window_rect(window_id: int, rect_out: Rect2, rect_in: Rect2) -> void
metodos.desc:
Sets window outer (with decorations) and inner (without decorations) bounds for assistive apps.
Note: This method is implemented on Linux, macOS, and Windows.
Note: Advanced users only! Window objects call this method automatically.

metodos.assinatura: update_add_action(id: RID, action: AccessibilityServer.AccessibilityAction, callable: Callable) -> void
metodos.desc: Adds a callback for the accessibility action (action which can be performed by using a special screen reader command or buttons on the Braille display), and marks this action as supported. The action callback receives one Variant argument, which value depends on action type.

Adds a child accessibility element.
Note: Node children and sub-elements are added to the child list automatically.

metodos.assinatura: update_add_custom_action(id: RID, action_id: int, action_description: String) -> void
metodos.desc: Adds support for a custom accessibility action. 'action_id' is passed as an argument to the callback of 'ACTION_CUSTOM' action.
